carpet.rule.commandPlayerTickingStage.de: Permission for /player <name> tickingStage, which changes a fake player's tick stage
carpet.rule.commandPlayerTickingStage.ex: true: everyone; ops: permission level 2+; false: disabled; or a minimum permission level 0-4
carpet.rule.commandPearlTrace.desc: Permission for the read-only /pearltrace list and show, which inspect ghost pearl leftovers
carpet.rule.commandPearlTrace.extra.0: true: everyone; ops: permission level 2+; false: disabled; or a minimum permission level 0-4
carpet.rule.commandPearlTracePurge.desc: Permission for /pearltrace purge, which removes ghost pearls from online players
carpet.rule.commandPearlTracePurge.extra: true: everyone; ops: permission level 2+; false: disabled; or a minimum permission level 0-4
carpet.rule.tripwireIgnoreDepartures.des: Fix MC-305475: a movement that only departs from the tripwire no longer powers it
carpet.rule.tripwireRestore.desc: Restore the pre-26.2 tripwire behaviour on 26.2+
carpet.rule.tripwireRestore.extra.0: false: vanilla behaviour of this version
carpet.rule.tripwireRestore.extra.1: true: roll back the MC-305475 fix
carpet.rule.tripwireRestore.extra.2: 26.3: on 26.2 only, change the tripwire's 0t scheduled tick to 1t
carpet.rule.fakePlayerTicksLikeRealPlaye: Make fake players tick like real players: doTick moves to the network phase and action packs to the async task phase
Per fake player, override with /player <player> tickingStage (global/invert/origin/likeReal) or the button in GCA's fake player menu
Overrides last for the current server run and reset on restart
With carpet-tis-addition installed, its machinery is used as-is and this mod only adds the per-player override
carpet.rule.ghostEnderPearlFix.extra.0: What it fixes: pearls vanishing after relogin, already-used pearls still teleporting the player, or pearls multiplying with each relogin
carpet.rule.ghostEnderPearlFix.extra.1: Hidden when carpet-igny-addition is installed; its same-name rule takes over
carpet.rule.ghostEnderPearlTrace.desc: Forensics for ghost ender pearls: record every teleport with its origin, count teleports per pearl UUID, and inspect or purge via /pearltrace
carpet.rule.ghostEnderPearlTrace.extra.0: A pearl can only teleport once, so 2+ teleports of the same UUID is proven ghost replay
carpet.rule.ghostEnderPearlTrace.extra.1: Works standalone and stacks on vanilla, carpet-igny-addition or ghostEnderPearlFix alike
carpet.rule.shulkerBulletPortalCleanup.d: Shulker bullets are discarded when passing through a portal
carpet.rule.shulkerBulletPortalCleanup.e: A bullet's guidance target resolves across dimensions, so after passing through it flies towards its pre-portal coordinates; clearing it before the teleport also spares the destination-side chunk loading
carpet.rule.shulkerBulletWeakChunkCleanu: Trigger-style cleanup of shulker bullets sitting in weakly loaded chunks
carpet.rule.witherSkullCleanup.desc: Trigger-style cleanup of wither skulls (normal and charged/blue) sitting in weakly loaded chunks
carpet.rule.minecartAcceleration.desc: Reintroduce the 1.21.5-26.2 minecart acceleration: bots can chain-mount carts and get ticked multiple times per tick
carpet.rule.minecartAcceleration.extra.0: 26.3 fixed the Minecart.interact return value, giving bots a 4gt use cooldown on mounting; when on, a successful mount returns PASS again, matching pre-26.3 behaviour
carpet.rule.minecartAcceleration.extra.1: Only exists on 26.3+; vanilla real players are unaffected
carpet.rule.mapRegistryLeakFix.desc: Vanilla clears a map's player records, but map optimizations such as Lithium rewrite that path and miss an edge case, so records pile up and leak
carpet.rule.mapRegistryLeakFix.extra.0: Carpet fake players are no longer added to map holder lists (they have no client that needs map updates)
carpet.rule.mapRegistryLeakFix.extra.1: The moment a player disconnects, their entries are removed from all loaded maps
carpet.rule.mapRegistryLeakFix.extra.2: On by default: the removal is one pass over the loaded maps per disconnect, scaling with map count
carpet.rule.reloginAvatarLeakFix.desc: Fix the relogin leak in Carpet-Org-Addition's 1.21.x line: the old fake player being logged out by relogin is never properly disconnected and lingers in memory
carpet.rule.reloginAvatarLeakFix.extra.0: The logout task skips fake players already marked removed, so the old player's disconnect never runs; fast relogin keeps producing such leftovers
carpet.rule.reloginAvatarLeakFix.extra.1: The disconnect is forced through while the duplicate save of an already-removed fake player is skipped (preserving ORG's riding-entity data protection; the two halves ship together)
carpet.rule.reloginAvatarLeakFix.extra.2: Requires carpet-org-addition; only exists below 26.1 (newer ORG v1.46.0+ fixed itself)
hfut.fakePlayerTickStage.stage.t: T - ticks like a real player (network phase)
hfut.fakePlayerTickStage.stage.f: F - ticks like a normal entity (entity phase)
hfut.fakePlayerTickStage.button.name: HFUT: tick stage invert
hfut.pearltrace.list.empty: No pearl teleports recorded (is ghostEnderPearlTrace on?)
hfut.pearltrace.show.last: last: %s owner=%s dim=%s pos=%s origin=%s born-at=%s
hfut.pearltrace.show.no_event: no teleport recorded in the recent window
hfut.pearltrace.show.no_copies: no leftover copies in online players' collections
hfut.pearltrace.player_offline: Player not online (purge only works on online players): %s
hfut.pearltrace.purge.header: About to remove a pearl from %s: %s
hfut.pearltrace.purge.no_pending: No removal pending (or the preview expired) - run the preview without confirm first
hfut.pearltrace.purge.expired: The preview timed out (60s) - preview again, then confirm
hfut.pearltrace.purge.stale: The pearl's teleport count changed since the preview - the preview is void, run it again
hfut.pearltrace.purge.done: %s: removed %s pearl(s); the next save rewrites their data cleanly
